summary: Adds computed normals or tangents to SOP geometry, commonly preparing surfaces for lighting and normal-map workflows.

key_params.name: comptang
key_params.note: Create tangent attributes on the geometry

common_gotchas: MikkTSpace fixes certain normal-map tangent discontinuities but is slower than the regular tangent method.
This SOP does not create arbitrary custom attributes; use CHOP to SOP or Script SOP for custom attribute creation.
Normals and tangents depend on valid source topology and texture coordinates.
key_concepts: Attribute Create SOP computes normals and tangents for SOP geometry.
Despite its name, the official page scopes this SOP to normal/tangent creation rather than arbitrary custom attributes.
MikkTSpace tangent generation can improve some normal-map workflows at a higher cook cost.
Normals and tangents depend on valid topology and texture-coordinate data in the source geometry.
